Facts below cover only Outpatient X-rays and Diagnostic Radiology Services (page 7), the imaging benefits in the list. Dental X-rays are left out because they are not Medicare outpatient X-rays.

For diagnostic radiology, the row gives $500 for all other services in an outpatient hospital and $250 in all other locations. I treated "all other locations" as unmapped and left it out. A single fact would need a setting, and `any` would be wrong because the hospital setting is priced separately. The out-of-network 20% coinsurance covers every setting, so it is one fact with setting `any`.

The diagnostic mammogram is $0 in network, with no setting named.

The $500 and $250 amounts apply to "all other diagnostic radiology services", which is not a clean imaging.diagnostic category because the mammogram is carved out. The mammogram is a diagnostic radiology service and the remaining services are "other than X-rays" and priced together. So imaging.diagnostic at outpatient_hospital for $500 is reasonable, though it excludes mammograms. I added a note on that fact.
